name: workforce-profile-readiness-lifecycle
objective: Close Captain Workforce provisioning, profile/readiness lifecycle and the direct/mobile plus DSH-internal readiness transports on one Workforce-owned truth.
truthOwner: Workforce owns Captain employment/profile/readiness lifecycle; DSH and app-captain consume projections but cannot invent employment truth.

tasks.objective: Converge mobile and internal Workforce readiness
tasks.currentProblem: Two transports can diverge if they derive readiness differently or use different actor/kind checks.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Workforce me/readiness and DSH internal Captain readiness to one canonical Workforce profile/state and shared decision semantics; ensure service-auth internal routes reject human bearer misuse and mobile routes reject other actors.
tasks.targetState: App-captain gate and DSH dispatch see the same Workforce truth for the same Captain/version.
tasks.action: Trace both transports, eliminate duplicate derivation, fix authorization and execute state-by-state comparison.
mustNotChange: Internal service routes never accept human bearer as authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Both transports agree for the same actor/state.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused transport/adaptor changes without restoring divergent readiness logic.

tasks.objective: Close Captain provisioning and lifecycle states
tasks.currentProblem: Provisioning, suspension/termination and profile completeness can leave stale usable sessions or dispatch eligibility.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise Captain creation/provisioning, missing/incomplete profile, active, suspension, termination, required documents/accreditation change and re-read; propagate versioned/audited state to app and DSH without local overrides.
tasks.targetState: Every Captain lifecycle transition has canonical write, readback and fail-closed consumers.
tasks.action: Audit exact Captain HR/admin writers, close missing persistence/readback and test transitions against app and DSH.
mustNotChange: Do not expand generic HR scope.
Do not let UI status become canonical.
Do not keep stale active readiness after lifecycle change.
acceptanceCriteria: Provisioning creates one canonical Captain profile.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused Captain lifecycle integration while preserving canonical Workforce history.
